vocabulary.meaning_en: a place where you stay or live
vocabulary.example: We found cheap accommodation near the beach.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a building where people pay to stay and get services
vocabulary.example: We stayed at a luxury hotel.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a cheap place to stay, usually sharing a room with other travellers
vocabulary.example: Backpackers often stay in hostels.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small hotel or private house where guests can stay
vocabulary.example: The guest house had only six rooms.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a holiday place with hotels, pools and activities
vocabulary.example: They spent a week at a beach resort.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a hotel near a highway for people travelling by car
vocabulary.example: We stopped at a motel on our road trip.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small guest house that offers a room and breakfast
vocabulary.example: We stayed in a lovely B&B in the countryside.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small, often old hotel or pub in the countryside
vocabulary.example: The old inn served great food.

vocabulary.meaning_en: places and services provided for people to use
vocabulary.example: The hotel has excellent facilities.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a room for one person
vocabulary.example: I booked a single room for two nights.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a room with one big bed for two people
vocabulary.example: Is there a double room available?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a set of connected rooms in a hotel
vocabulary.example: The suite has a bedroom and a sitting room.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the desk where you check in and get your key
vocabulary.example: Please leave your key at reception.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the large open area at the entrance of a hotel
vocabulary.example: I'll meet you in the lobby at seven.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a plastic card used to open a hotel room door
vocabulary.example: My key card stopped working.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a large area of water for swimming
vocabulary.example: The swimming pool is open until 10 p.m.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a room with equipment for exercise
vocabulary.example: I go to the hotel gym every morning.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place for relaxing treatments like massage and steam
vocabulary.example: She booked a massage at the spa.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to arrive at a hotel and get your key
vocabulary.example: We checked in at 2 p.m.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to pay and leave a hotel
vocabulary.example: We have to check out by 11 a.m.

vocabulary.meaning_en: money you pay first, often returned later
vocabulary.example: The hotel asked for a deposit at check-in.

vocabulary.meaning_en: food and drinks brought to your hotel room
vocabulary.example: We ordered room service for breakfast.

vocabulary.meaning_en: washing clothes; clothes that need washing
vocabulary.example: The hotel offers a laundry service.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a hotel worker who helps guests book tables and tickets and gives advice
vocabulary.example: The concierge booked us a table for dinner.

vocabulary.meaning_en: pleasant and relaxing to use
vocabulary.example: The bed was very comfortable.

vocabulary.meaning_en: very expensive and of the highest comfort
vocabulary.example: They stayed in a luxurious suite.

vocabulary.meaning_en: costing little money
vocabulary.example: The hostel is cheap but clean.

vocabulary.meaning_en: reasonable in price; not too expensive
vocabulary.note_ar: من afford = يقدر على تحمّل التكلفة
vocabulary.example: We found an affordable hotel in the centre.

vocabulary.meaning_en: costing a lot of money
vocabulary.example: Hotels are more expensive in summer.

vocabulary.meaning_en: free and ready to be used
vocabulary.example: Is there a room available tonight?

vocabulary.meaning_en: with no free rooms or places left
vocabulary.example: Sorry, we are fully booked this weekend.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the title of an email
vocabulary.example: Write a clear subject for your email.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to say that something is true or definite
vocabulary.example: Please confirm your booking by email.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the right or chance to use or enter something
vocabulary.example: Guests have free access to the gym.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to provide or make something available
vocabulary.example: Do you offer airport transfers?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to have something as part of the whole
vocabulary.example: The price includes breakfast.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an arrangement to have a room, seat or ticket
vocabulary.example: Thank you for your booking.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a traveller who carries a backpack and spends little money
vocabulary.example: The hostel was full of backpackers.

vocabulary.meaning_en: two beds, one on top of the other
vocabulary.example: I slept on the top bunk bed.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a machine that carries people between floors
vocabulary.example: Take the elevator to the fifth floor.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a soft coat you wear after a bath
vocabulary.example: There are two bathrobes in the bathroom.

fine_lines.title: hotel vs hostel vs motel
fine_lines.explanation_ar: hotel مبنى تقليدي فيه غرف خاصة واستقبال وخدمة غرف ومرافق مثل الجيم وحمام السباحة. hostel مكان رخيص جداً تشارك فيه الغرفة مع آخرين بأسرّة بطابقين وحمامات مشتركة، وهو محبوب بين الطلاب والمسافرين بميزانية قليلة. motel (motor hotel) فندق على الطرق السريعة للمسافرين بسياراتهم، وغرفه تفتح مباشرة على موقف السيارات.

examples.sentence: We stayed at a luxury hotel.
We stopped at a motel on our road trip.

fine_lines.title: booking vs reservation
fine_lines.explanation_ar: المعنى واحد تقريباً: حجز غرفة أو مقعد أو طاولة. booking أشيع في الإنجليزية البريطانية وفي الكلام اليومي، و reservation أشيع في الإنجليزية الأمريكية وفي السياقات الرسمية. والفعلان: book و reserve.

examples.sentence: I'd like to make a reservation for a double room.

fine_lines.title: cheap vs affordable vs expensive
fine_lines.explanation_ar: cheap رخيص السعر، وقد توحي أحياناً بجودة أقل. affordable سعره مناسب ومقدور عليه وقيمته جيدة مقابل المال، ليس رخيصاً ولا غالياً. expensive غالي الثمن.

examples.sentence: The hostel is cheap but noisy.
We found an affordable hotel with a pool.
Five-star hotels are very expensive in summer.

expressions.meaning_ar: يؤجّل القرار لليوم التالي ليفكر فيه بهدوء
expressions.example: I like the hotel's offer, but I'd like to sleep on it before I book.

expressions.meaning_ar: أودّ أن (أسلوب مهذب بدل I want to)
expressions.example: I'd like to make a reservation for a double room.
A room with a sea view? That sounds perfect!
We can't sleep on it; the rooms are selling out fast.
The breakfast was good value for money.

grammar.title: Future perfect with deadlines: by + time
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم المستقبل التام (will have + التصريف الثالث) للحديث عن أهداف أو إنجازات ستكون قد اكتملت بحلول موعد محدد. كلمة by هنا تعني «بحلول / قبل هذا الوقت»: by the end of the year، by next week.
examples: By the end of the year, we will have built the hotel.
By next week, I will have saved enough money.
By Friday, they will have finished the rooms.

grammar.title: By the time + present simple
grammar.explanation_ar: بعد by the time نضع فاعلاً وفعلاً في المضارع البسيط وليس will. نقول by the time Emma arrives وليس by the time Emma will arrive، وهذا من أشهر أخطاء الطلاب.
examples: By the time Emma arrives, the hotel will have prepared her room.
By the time we check out, we will have paid the bill.

questions.explanation_ar: motel = motor hotel على الطرق السريعة.

questions.explanation_ar: إنجاز سيكتمل بحلول موعد محدد = will have + التصريف الثالث.

questions.question: "Let me sleep on it" means:
choices: I want to think about it before deciding
questions.explanation_ar: sleep on it = يؤجل القرار لليوم التالي ليفكر.

questions.question: "All rooms are fully booked" means:
questions.explanation_ar: fully booked = محجوز بالكامل، لا توجد غرف.

questions.question: The hotel worker who books restaurants and tickets for guests is the:
questions.explanation_ar: concierge موظف الاستعلامات الذي يساعد الضيوف.

questions.question: A set of connected rooms in a hotel is a:

choices: the number of services and facilities
